name: @pipeworx/mcp-hud

tools.name: hud_fair_market_rents
tools.description: Get HUD Fair Market Rent ceilings by bedroom count (0–4+) for a county or metropolitan area and year. AREA-LEVEL ANNUAL STATISTICS only — one benchmark rent figure per area per bedroom count, published yearly by HUD for housing programs. NOT rental listings: it cannot find homes or apartments actually for rent (for that, use rentcast search_rental_listings). Pass area_name with a state code for ordinary names such as "Travis County"; the tool resolves HUD's required entity ID. A 5-digit county FIPS is also accepted and expanded to HUD's 10-digit county ID. Omit year for HUD's latest available fiscal year.

state_code.description: Two-letter state code (e.g., "CA", "NY", "TX"). Required to get state-level summary.

area_name.description: County or metro name to resolve (e.g., "Travis County" or "Austin-Round Rock"). Use instead of entity_id.

entity_id.description: HUD entity ID, 5-digit county FIPS, or HUD metro code. Omit to resolve area_name or get all areas in the state.

year.description: Fiscal year (e.g., 2024). Omit for the most recent year.

tools.name: hud_income_limits
tools.description: Check income eligibility thresholds (extremely low, very low, low-income) for HUD programs by area and family size. Returns income limits by category. Use to determine program qualification.

entity_id.description: FIPS code or metro area code for a specific area. Omit to get all areas in the state.

year.description: Fiscal year (e.g., 2024). Omit for the most recent year.

tools.name: hud_crosswalk
tools.description: Map ZIP codes to census tracts, counties, CBSAs, and congressional districts. Returns geographic identifiers. Use to translate between location code formats or join datasets.

query.description: Input value: ZIP code (for types 1-4), or FIPS county code (for type 7). Example: "90210" or "06037".

tools.name: hud_chas
tools.description: Get housing affordability data by income level and family type. Returns household counts with cost burdens, overcrowding, and housing problems. Use for housing needs assessment.

entity_id.description: FIPS code for a specific county or place. Omit to get state-level data.

year.description: Data year (e.g., 2020). Omit for the most recent available.

tools.name: hud_list_states
tools.description: List all U.S. state codes and names. Returns state abbreviations and full names. Use to validate or discover state codes for other HUD tools.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hud forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hud pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
